findings.requirement: One canonical repository lineage must carry both consolidated work and FFDRM authority.
findings.observed: PR #50 contains the 291-commit consolidated development-system lineage while PR #52 independently introduced FFDRM from master and was 291 commits behind the consolidation head.
findings.root_cause: Forensic-standard adoption was developed on master rather than rebased onto the retained-work consolidation lineage.
findings.remediation: Created this forensic rebase from consolidation SHA c81ed32... and integrated FFDRM into that lineage.
verification: compare remediation branch against consolidation base

findings.requirement: Every admitted project must have its own content-bound FORENSIC_BUILD_READY certificate.
findings.observed: The divergent FFDRM implementation used one repository-global DIAL certificate reference for all registered projects.
findings.root_cause: Project admission and forensic readiness were composed as repository-global state rather than project-scoped Development Pack state.
findings.remediation: Forensic gate now resolves projectSlug, project registry and projects/<slug>/development-pack/pack.json, synthesizing a certificate bound to project ID, baseline SHA, pack hash and FFDRM standard.
verification: project A ready / project B missing-pack mutation test

findings.requirement: Project identity and forensic authority must reach the real task execution path.
findings.observed: Adaptive planning and Task Execution Envelopes were DIAL-defaulted and did not bind a project-specific forensic certificate.
findings.root_cause: Universal project admission was added after the DIAL-specific execution path and identity was not threaded through the later boundary.
findings.remediation: Adaptive planner/runner and Task Execution Envelope now propagate project_slug/project_id and bind standard version plus certificate fingerprint; stale or changed authority refuses execution.

findings.requirement: The Development Pack must enforce FFDRM F0-F15, not only broad preparation presence.
findings.observed: The universal pack had GATE-00..13 but did not explicitly prove state persistence, causal reachability, secret boundaries, adversarial forensics, symbiotic closure, production reachability or executed mutation.
findings.root_cause: The universal pack predates the owner-adopted FFDRM forensic standard.
findings.remediation: Existing Development Pack remains single substrate and now appends executable F0-F15 gates; overall build_ready cannot pass while forensic gates are blocked.

findings.requirement: Recovery qualification must test the current canonical topology.
findings.observed: Netcup/Oracle topology declares WireGuard while the bootstrap manifest and recovery probe still required Tailscale authentication.
findings.root_cause: Recovery readiness artifacts were not invalidated/reconciled when the cross-cloud overlay changed.
findings.remediation: Manifest, network probe, supply-chain pin, Netcup image bootstrap, recovery verifier, tests, README, green board and gap register now use canonical wg-dial WireGuard.

findings.requirement: Logical execution authority must survive infrastructure-provider migration.
findings.observed: Orchestrator provenance was hard-coded as EXTERNAL_ORACLE_ORCHESTRATOR after Netcup became canonical CONTROL_AUTHORITY.
findings.root_cause: Physical provider identity leaked into the logical authority contract.
findings.remediation: Provenance contract is provider-neutral EXTERNAL_DIAL_ORCHESTRATOR across runtime, qualification scripts and tests.

findings.requirement: DIAL Development System universal E2E independence must be proven before system FORENSIC_BUILD_READY.
findings.observed: Canonical universal-system specification explicitly states live universal E2E certification pending and requires DIAL product, DDE, existing non-DIAL app and clean-slate unrelated project through the same pipeline.
findings.root_cause: Architecture and repository foundation were completed before cross-class live conformance evidence.
findings.remediation: Keep DEVELOPMENT_SYSTEM Gate 13/F11/F13/F14 blocked until four-class execution, isolation mutation, release/rollback and recovery drills are evidenced.
verification: four-class Development Pack + task dispatch receipts

findings.requirement: Provider-first execution must have at least one actually usable governed provider execution path and required ingress.
findings.observed: Green execution board records provider-container execution surface and authenticated Cloudflare provider ingress as unresolved runtime/external proof.
findings.root_cause: Repository integration exists but external provider workspace/ingress qualification is incomplete.
findings.remediation: Qualify eligible provider execution surface, authenticated ingress and signed project-bound execution receipt on final SHA.
verification: signed venue decision and execution receipt

findings.requirement: The development system's own project-scoped Development Pack must produce a current FORENSIC_BUILD_READY certificate.
findings.observed: Repository code can now derive the certificate, but the mutable control-state pack for dial-development-system has not been recompiled/evidenced against this remediation SHA.
findings.root_cause: Certificate is correctly runtime/content-bound and therefore cannot be truthfully manufactured from repository prose alone.
findings.remediation: After integration/deployment, seed/rebaseline dial project pack, record F0-F15 evidence, run forensic gate and preserve certificate/receipt.
verification: certificate fingerprint bound to deployed SHA

findings.requirement: Canonical WireGuard recovery path must be exercised, not only configured.
findings.observed: Repository now tests WireGuard structurally; exact final-SHA reciprocal Netcup↔Oracle recovery proof is not available in this audit session.
findings.root_cause: Live recovery is environment evidence and cannot be proved by repository tests.
findings.remediation: Run overlay peer verification and bounded reciprocal recovery drill after final deployment.

findings.requirement: Independent live runtime audit requires an available authorized administration surface.
findings.observed: All Remote Desktop Commander device records visible to this audit were offline, so this session could not independently execute host qualification.
findings.root_cause: Audit connector availability, not repository implementation.
findings.remediation: Re-establish authorized live administration surface or run the same qualification through the canonical control plane and retain immutable evidence.

findings.requirement: Project preparation blockers must remain project-scoped.
findings.observed: DIAL product CT-1/CT-2/CT-7 contract-specificity gaps were previously treated as if they blocked universal development-system readiness.
findings.root_cause: Product and shared-system readiness were represented by one repository-level certificate.
findings.remediation: Project-scoped Development Packs/certificates separate DIAL product preparation from dial-development-system readiness. CT-1/2/7 remain real blockers for affected DIAL product work until their project pack proves the required feature-specific contracts.
verification: system certificate does not imply product readiness
